provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Paladins of the West Kingdom rules (Garphill Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Join the 2 Main Board parts
Townsfolk draw pile on the left; 5 faceup above the top left
Wall Cards shuffled facedown above the center
Tax supply above the board: 5-8 Silver for your player count, as the icons printed there show
Debt Cards Unpaid side up above the top right; Suspicion Cards shuffled facedown to their right
Outsider draw pile on the right; 6 faceup below the bottom right
3 random King's Order Cards facedown on the left end, 5 random King's Favour Cards facedown to their right; box the rest unseen
Tavern Cards shuffled facedown below the bottom left; Silver, Provisions and Workers in a supply
Each player: Player Board, 8 Workshops, 7 Monks, 7 Outposts, 7 Jars, 3 Attribute Markers on zero
{s} Silver and {p} Provision each
Shuffle your 12 Paladin Cards into a facedown draw pile
Random Start Player; in reverse turn order each recruits 1 visible Townsfolk for free, then refill the row
Flip a spare Player Board to its AI side; place the 7 Monks, Outposts and Absolves on it
Stack the AI's Attribute Markers on zero: Influence at the bottom, Faith in the middle, Strength on top
Resource Marker on the leftmost space of the AI's Resource Track
Set aside the 5 King's Favour Scheme Cards; shuffle the other Scheme Cards facedown on the AI board

Difficulty: reveal 1 (Easy), 3 (Standard) or 5 (Hard) of the 6 King's Order Cards and put an AI Workshop on each matching action space of the AI board; then reshuffle them and place 3 on the Main Board as usual
1 AI Workshop on each King's Order Card and 1 King's Favour Scheme Card faceup on each King's Favour Card on the Main Board
When the last Silver leaves the Tax supply an Inquisition occurs: whoever has the most Suspicion gains a Debt
Solo: reveal only 2 Tavern Cards each round and you always act first
Round 1: each player draws Paladins and takes Workers, starting with the Start Player
